title: Admin audit claim generator with WORM stamping and region-aware retention
creator: Ava Chen
description: Build an internal 'Audit Claim Generator' service that packages admin action events (access grants, config changes, role updates) into tamper-evident evidence bundles suitable for WORM-backed archival and region-bound retention policies. The service must produce signed, time-stamped claim packages, publish an indexable manifest, and wire into our existing archive pipeline so legal/compliance teams can pull certified exports per region and retention window. Key goals: (1) make admin-event exports auditable and verifiable by third parties, (2) respect data residency and retention rules per customer and region, (3) integrate with HSM/KMS for cryptographic stamping, and (4) provide automated reporting endpoints for compliance operations.
background_and_rationale: Current admin audit logs are stored as event streams with eventual export. Compliance requires certified, unmodifiable proof artifacts for selective retention periods and jurisdictional residency. Existing approaches (ad-hoc snapshots, S3 immutability flags) lack standardized manifests, cryptographic stamping, or per-customer residency enforcement. This ticket delivers a repeatable pipeline to generate WORM-compatible evidence packages, reducing legal friction and manual export work for enterprise customers.
success_metrics: Support packaging of admin events into signed claim bundles for 3 regions (us-west, eu-central, ap-southeast)
Automated generation and upload of manifests to WORM vault with HSM signature for 95% of scheduled exports
Integration test demonstrating retrieval and verification of a claim bundle using public verification key
Compliance team acceptance and reduction of manual audit-export time from days to <2 hours
acceptance_criteria: Claim generator accepts JSON event stream and emits a single signed claim bundle (SHA256 manifest + signature) per requested time window
Bundles are written to the designated WORM storage endpoint with region tags that map to residency policy
Manifest includes origin keys: tenant_id, window_start, window_end, sequence_range, hash_tree_root, signer_key_id
HSM-backed signing integrated and key rotation handled via existing KMS connector
API endpoints for on-demand claim generation and scheduled exports with role-based access control
Automated test suite that verifies manifest signature and hash chain integrity
Operational dashboard tile showing export success/failure and per-tenant export latencies
implementation_steps: Design manifest schema and canonical serialization format (RFC draft + examples)
Prototype local signer using our KMS simulator and define HSM call patterns
Create claim-generator service scaffold (Go) with streaming input and bundle output
Wire claim-generator to retention policy service to compute region and retention windows
Add writer adapter for WORM storage (S3 Object Lock + vault metadata + assertion headers)
Build verification tooling (CLI) to validate bundle signatures and hash chain
Create scheduled job runner and expose secured API for on-demand exports
Add observability: traces, per-tenant metrics, and dashboard panels
Run compliance review and remediation loop based on feedback
Prepare runbook for legal/custody in the Console and handoff docs
risks_and_open_questions: How to support customers whose residency spans multiple regions within the same tenant? (per-tenant vs per-resource tagging)
Edge case: partial window exports when downstream archival latency prevents timely WORM sealing
KMS/HSM throughput limits could throttle bulk signing jobs during large exports
Legal acceptance criteria differ by region — require compliance SME sign-off for manifest contents
